verdict.rationale: First-party marketing says founders can give their accountant direct access to the books (docs-10). It also cites custom roles and control over what others can see (docs-4), custom access for up to 25 users on Advanced (docs-25), and an accountant-side Intuit Accountant Suite (docs-27). Together these cover the core story of inviting an external accountant with scoped access. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the invite flow and the scope of the accountant role, explicit evidence that the accountant can adjust entries rather than just view reports, clarity on whether custom roles need the Advanced tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
